choices.label: Several different keys with the same hash.
choices.feedback: Different keys can have the same hash and must remain distinguishable.

choices.label: Only a flag saying the bucket is occupied.

choices.label: Only one key, replacing earlier collisions.

questions.prompt: How should a membership query use its bucket?

choices.label: Compare only the keys' hash values.

choices.label: Accept any nonempty bucket.

choices.label: Check for the exact requested key.
